f3_program: collection("bucket.candies", "candy", "bucket", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))
collection("candy_eaters", "person", "group", source("all of them ate until they cried"))
member("candy_eaters", "nellie", source("Nellie can eat 12 sourball candies before crying"))
member("candy_eaters", "jacob", source("Jacob can only manage half of that number of candies"))
member("candy_eaters", "lana", source("Lana can only do three fewer than Jacob"))
observe(at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("Nellie can eat 12 sourball candies before crying"))

fraction_of(at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Jacob can only manage half of that number of candies"))
offset(at("lana.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), -3, "count", source("Lana can only do three fewer than Jacob"))
observe(at("bucket.candies.count", "initial"), 30, "count", source("a bucket of 30 candies"))
consume("nellie_eats_until_crying", "nellie", at("bucket.candies.count", "current"), at("nellie.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("jacob_eats_until_crying", "jacob", at("bucket.candies.count", "current"), at("jacob.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))
consume("lana_eats_until_crying", "lana", at("bucket.candies.count", "current"), at("lana.sourball_candies.crying_threshold.count", "current"), source("all of them ate until they cried"))

quotient_relation(at("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_share.count", "current"), at("bucket.candies.count", "current"), at("candy_eaters.count", "current"), source("divide the remaining candies in the bucket equally"))
query("value", at("candy_eaters.remaining_candy_share.count", "current"))
assumptions: The bucket's candies are the sourball candies referenced throughout.
Eating until crying consumes each person's stated crying-threshold quantity.
The requested yearly total requires a year-to-month conversion that is neither stated by the source nor included in the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: collection("car_buyers", "person", "group", source("A group of six friends planned to buy a car"))
observe(at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), 6, "count", source("A group of six friends"))
member("car_buyers", "brad", source("Brad decided not to join in the purchase of the car"))
observe(at("car_purchase.unpaid_cost", "initial"), 1700, "dollar", source("The cost of the car is $1700"))
add("car_wash_fundraiser", "car_buyers", at("car_buyers.purchase_funds", "current"), 500, source("At the car wash, they earn $500"))
remove("apply_car_wash_funds", "car_buyers", at("car_purchase.unpaid_cost", "current"), event_field("car_wash_fundraiser", "quantity"), source("which would be taken out of the total cost"))

quotient_relation(at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car_purchase.unpaid_cost", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "initial"), source("The remaining cost would be split between the six friends"))
remove("brad_withdrawal", "brad", at("car_buyers.count", "current"), 1, source("Brad decided not to join in the purchase of the car"))
quotient_relation(at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "now"), at("car_purchase.unpaid_cost", "current"), at("car_buyers.count", "current"), source("they plan to share the cost equally"))
query("difference", at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "before_brad_withdrawal"), at("car_purchase.per_friend_payment", "now"))
assumptions: Brad is one of the original six friends.
The remaining participants continue to divide the unpaid cost equally.

f3_program: observe(at("road.unpaved_length", "initial"), 16, "mile", source("a newly constructed 16-mile road"))
observe(at("asphalt.gravel_bags_per_truckload", "current"), 2, "bag/truckload", source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel"))
multiple(at("asphalt.gravel_bags_per_truckload", "current"), at("asphalt.pitch_barrels_per_truckload", "current"), 5, source("five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch"))
observe(at("road_paving.asphalt_truckloads_per_mile", "current"), 3, "truckload/mile", source("It takes three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))
remove("pave_day_1", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), 4, source("The company paved 4 miles of road on one day"))
offset("roadwork_company.paving.day_2.length", scale(event_field("pave_day_1", "quantity"), 2), -1, "mile", source("one mile less than double that on the second day"))
remove("pave_day_2", "roadwork_company", at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), "roadwork_company.paving.day_2.length", source("then one mile less than double that on the second day"))

rate_relation(at("roadwork_company.asphalt_truckloads.required", "day_3"), at("road_paving.asphalt_truckloads_per_mile", "current"), at("road.unpaved_length", "current"), source("It takes three truckloads of asphalt to pave each mile of road"))

rate_relation(at("roadwork_company.pitch_barrels.required", "day_3"), at("asphalt.pitch_barrels_per_truckload", "current"), at("roadwork_company.asphalt_truckloads.required", "day_3"), source("Each truckloads of asphalt uses two bags of gravel and five times as many bags of gravel as it does barrels of pitch to make"))
query("value", at("roadwork_company.pitch_barrels.required", "day_3"))
assumptions: The gravel-to-pitch comparison applies to the numerical bag and barrel quantities used in each truckload.

f3_program: collection("cd_store.cds", "cd", "cd_store", source("the total number of CDs was 200"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("the total number of CDs was 200"))
percent_of(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), 40, source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each"))

sum_relation(at("cd_store.cds.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "initial"), source("40% of the CDs cost $10 each, and the rest cost $5 each"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.unit_price", "current"), 10, "dollar/cd", source("$10 each"))
observe(at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.unit_price", "current"), 5, "dollar/cd", source("$5 each"))
collection("prince.purchased_cds", "cd", "prince", source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each, and all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_ten_dollar_cds", "prince", at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "current"), at("prince.purchased_cds.ten_dollar.count", "current"), fraction(at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("Prince bought half the CDs sold at $10 each"))

transfer("prince_buys_five_dollar_cds", "prince", at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "current"), at("prince.purchased_cds.five_dollar.count", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.count", "initial"), source("all of the CDs sold at $5 each"))
same(at("prince.purchased_cds.ten_dollar.unit_price", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.ten_dollar.unit_price", "current"), source("CDs sold at $10 each"))
same(at("prince.purchased_cds.five_dollar.unit_price", "current"), at("cd_store.cds.five_dollar.unit_price", "current"), source("CDs sold at $5 each"))
query("sum", "prince.purchased_cds.unit_prices", "current")
